answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a hardware-rooted attestation key woven into a Byzantine fault-tolerant membership trellis, so a single physical node cannot sprout many voting voices. New agents must submit a verifiable plume of prior stake and liveness proofs before admission, making mass identity forge attempts costly and detectable. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
